title: TFC Anvil Hepler
description: Mod for simplified forging. It all.
body:
TfcAnvilHelper is a lightweight helper mod for the anvil in TerraFirmaCraft (and modpacks like TerraFirmaGreg). It handles all the math for you, allowing you to focus on the forging process rather than counting clicks.

How to Use: Open the anvil interface.

Click the ⧉ button (the overlay icon) at the top of the screen.

Target Value: Enter the number currently indicated by the arrow on the anvil.

Actions: Specify the final 2 or 3 required actions (as dictated by the recipe). If an action is not needed, select "-".

Click "Calculate".

A notification displaying the first action will appear at the bottom of the screen. Once you have performed that action on the anvil, the mod will automatically display the next one.

To skip an action, simply click on the notification itself.
